motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda with an amendment to Item 14.B. to include the Planning Commission ’s recommen ded Condition 2 . • Condition 2: The Shared Parking and Maintenance Agreement be filed with Staff as part of the Site Plan Application . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent items passed with a shared parking condition
motions.summary: The council passed its consent items in one vote and added a Planning Commission condition: the project in item 14.B must file a shared parking and maintenance agreement with staff with its site plan.
motions.impact: The condition applies to the developer behind item 14.B, whom this record does not name. The motion does not list the other consent items, so it cannot say what they change.
